message_en: 💡 Tip: Sleep under a mosquito net every night to prevent malaria. Make sure the net is intact and tuck it under your mattress.
message_sw: 💡 Ushauri: Lala chini ya chandarua kila usiku ili kuzuia malaria. Hakikisha chandarua haini na tuckia chini ya kitanda.

message_en: 🥗 Tip: Eat a balanced diet with fruits and vegetables daily. Include proteins, grains, and dairy for optimal health.
message_sw: 🥗 Ushauri: Kula lishe bora yenye matunda na mboga kila siku. Jaza na protini, nafaka, na uzamili kwa afya nzuri.

message_en: 🚰 Tip: Wash your hands with soap for at least 20 seconds before eating and after using the toilet.
message_sw: 🚰 Ushauri: Fua mikono yako kwa sabuni kwa dakika 20 angalau kabla ya kula na baada ya choo.

message_en: 🏃 Tip: Exercise for at least 30 minutes daily. Walking, running, or dancing are all great options.
message_sw: 🏃 Ushauri: Fanya mazoezi kwa angalau dakika 30 kila siku. Kutembea, kukimbia, au kusambaza vimba ni chaguo nzuri.

message_en: 💧 Tip: Drink at least 8 glasses of water daily. Staying hydrated helps your body function properly.
message_sw: 💧 Ushauri: Kunywa angalau glasi 8 za maji kila siku. Kuwa na maji yanaungu husaidia mwili kutenda vizuri.

message_en: 😴 Tip: Get 7-8 hours of sleep each night. Good sleep improves your immune system and mental health.
message_sw: 😴 Ushauri: Lala 7-8 saa kila usiku. Usingizi mzuri inaboresha kinga ya mwili na akili.

message_en: 💉 Tip: Keep up with your vaccinations. Talk to your doctor about which vaccines you need.
message_sw: 💉 Ushauri: Endelea na chanjo zako. Ongeana na daktari kuhusu chanjo unazohitaji.
